description: Exercises the project-override path (Step 3). Changeset is one TypeScript test, src/widget.spec.ts, which matches no reviewer's DEFAULT test triggers (test-reviewer defaults to **/*Test.* / **/src/test/**; ui-test-reviewer wants *.test.tsx). The seeded .claude/pipeline.json overrides reviewers.test-reviewer to [**/*.spec.ts], so test-reviewer can only fire via the override — if the router ignored the file, read the old review-triggers.json name, or failed to descend into the reviewers key, test-reviewer would be skipped. arch-reviewer and refactor-advisor also fire, on their widened **/src/** trigger and not via any override; they are listed so the assertion stays honest about who is dispatched. Routing is path-only, so the file is created empty.
